findings.claim: The briefing is to name the `audit` skill, but main has no audit skill. plugin/skills/ on main holds only continue, handoff and write-docs. `audit` (plus architecture-review, decision-log-review and practices-review) lives in the audit-agent-and-skills ticket, which is still in building and is not in this plan's depends_on. If this ticket lands first, the briefing sends every session to a skill that does not exist (ADR 0002 routing becomes wrong in a new way). The 'four kmctl skills' count and the test 'fails when a kmctl skill is not named' also have no fixed meaning: a hard-coded list of four goes stale, and a list read from plugin/skills/ has three skills today and seven after audit-agent-and-skills lands. The Intent also cites plugin/skills/audit/evals/, which is not on main. Fix: add audit-agent-and-skills to depends_on (or drop `audit` from the list), and say which skills the briefing names and where the test gets that list.
